mapper.sql: ts.*, p.code AS project_code, p.name AS project_name, t.name AS task_name, u.nickname AS user_name, au.nickname AS approve_by_name
FROM pm_timesheet ts JOIN pm_project p ON p.id = ts.project_id LEFT JOIN pm_task t ON t.id = ts.task_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ts.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_user au ON au.id = ts.approve_by
